purpose: Measure the production-route decode throughput of fp16 recurrent state (HIPENGINE_GGUF_FP16_RECURRENT_STATE=1) against the FP32 state baseline at c1/c4/native_c8 on gfx1151, with the decode kernel path held identical between the two routes (fp16-state indexed-singleton decode sibling, committed b4f6e135c). This is the evidence for R2's deferred concurrency value now that the native c8 GEMV owner exists.

protocol.command: python3 scripts/gguf_packed_ar_bench.py --model /models/gguf/Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_S.gguf --backend hip_gfx1151 --quant gguf_q4_k_s --route production --configurations c1,c4,native_c8 --prompt-token-id 9707 --prompt-length 512 --decode-steps 64 --measured-runs 3 --warmup-runs 1 --compiler-version-file /tmp/qwen38-task22-q5-dense-tile8-integration/hipcc-version.txt --require-cached-build
protocol.session: both runs back-to-back on host gfx1151, same warm GPU, same cached builds; fp16 at 2026-08-20T10:25Z then fp32 at 10:30Z
protocol.notes: Raw production-route measurement packet; the packed-AR bench reports partial_measurement_complete (c2/chunked_c8/serial_c4 not requested), native_c8_rows_match_c4=True in both.

implications.retention: Retained as the fp16-state production-route measurement: c4 +3.14%, native_c8 +3.07%, c1 +0.73% (non-regressive). Consistent with the 2026-08-18 c=N roofline direction (c4 3.1%, c8 5.9% bandwidth-bound upper bounds); the c8 measured 3.1% sits below the roofline because MLP/attention GEMM work also scales with concurrency.
implications.default_promotion: fp16-state remains behind HIPENGINE_GGUF_FP16_RECURRENT_STATE=1; FP32 remains the strict default. Promotion to the public production-profile default additionally requires the complete serving-packet SLO-goodput gate (>=3% goodput, <=1% c1 regression per EXECUTION-PROFILES section 2.1), which has not been run.
implications.prior_confounded_run: The 2026-08-20 18:42 fp16 run used the segments decode fallback (c4 10.582, native_c8 7.031 tok/s) because the fp16 indexed-singleton decode kernel did not yet exist; it is superseded by this fair run (c4 10.995, native_c8 7.410).
